title: Mohnish Pabrai's Session with YPO Delhi on July 9, 2024
summary:
His book, Dhando investor, offers a unique perspective on low-risk, high-returned
investing, making complex financial strategies, accessible. High gross margin, not e-commerce, which is a low-gross margin
in high growth, high growth, yet outlandish valuation. Anytime we're going to make any capital allocation decision in the business,
in dollars, we want the money back in two years.
